provider_patterns.notes: <stream> is the path segment of the resort's player iframe https://player.brownrice.com/embed/<stream> (also that page's og:image). 1280x720 or 1920x1080 JPEG, no Last-Modified, ?t= and foreign Referer fine, ACAO *. Live: hashes of 4 Whistler cams changed over 7 min. Used here by Stevens Pass, White Pass, Mt Ashland, Whistler Blackcomb.
<player_id> from HDRelay.create({id:...}) or div.hdrelay-player data-id. Config JSON also carries camera latitude/longitude (sometimes wrong). Last-Modified sent. Used by Mt Hood Meadows, Sun Valley.

302 to the newest dated JPEG on storageN.roundshot.com, Last-Modified sent, ?t= and Referer fine. id, hash and camera lat/lon/alt are in https://<client>.roundshot.com/<cam>/settings.json. This fixed URL makes the structure.json lookup unnecessary. centerprev = 630x450 crop (popup-friendly); thumbnail ~1000-1600x150 strip; quarter ~4000-5600x512. Used by Crystal, Whitefish, Jackson Hole, Moonlight Basin, Spanish Peaks, Schweitzer. Big Sky's own Roundshot is frozen at 2020-03-22.

Fixed latest-frame object in a public GCS bucket, Last-Modified sent. Cam ids (and a lat/long) come from the page's Prism JSONP php.prismcam.com/public/helpers/cam_init.php (page id from div class violet-NNN / luma-NNN). Dated per-frame paths also exist but are not needed. A retired cam's bucket returns 403. Used by Bogus Basin, Sun Valley, Big Sky.

Alias from the player iframe g1.ipcamlive.com/player/player.php?alias=... 302 to https://sNN.ipcamlive.com/streams/<id>/snapshot.jpg with current Last-Modified; 404 while the stream is offline (many resume in winter). Used by Blacktail, Snowbowl, Lookout Pass, Apex, Manning Park, Sasquatch; Antelope Butte and Sovereign Lake aliases are offline now.

IDs from the CameraPlayer.aspx?parentID=..&shareID=.. iframe; the page's sesID session parameter is not needed and not used. Full-size last upload with Last-Modified; an offline camera returns a 160x120 PNG placeholder (~6 kB) with 200, so check type/size. The API host's robots.txt is 'Disallow: /' (terms question). Used by Mt Washington, Bluewood, Snowy Range.

No fixed latest URL found. Frames ~every 10 min, named in Europe/Paris local time (01:50 UTC -> 03-50). The hourly job must read og:image from the player page (robots.txt allows it; all players in https://www.skaping.com/sitemap.players.xml). Cams using this carry img_resolver='og:image of page'. Used by Grouse, Cypress.

provider_patterns.provider: Resorts of the Canadian Rockies (Fernie, Kicking Horse, Kimberley; also Nakiska outside the boxes)
provider_patterns.notes: Fixed per-cam filenames listed on each resort's /conditions/mountain-cam/ page; Last-Modified sent; off-season they update every few hours.
The image-widget uid differs from the stream-player uid and is usable only where the owner publishes it (Mt Hood Meadows). Wetmet stream players are HLS with signed tokens: video only.

provider_patterns.provider: YouTube live (incl. CamStreamer and SeeJH, which redirect to YouTube)
provider_patterns.notes: NOT used in cams. Public, no key, max-age 300; the Cypress Eagle Chair frame changed over 7 min, and Snow King base, Bridger Red Chair and Big Sky showed current night frames. But Snow King mid, Loup Loup, Crosscut and Great Divide showed daylight after dark (hours old), and Mt Spokane's snow stake returns a custom promo thumbnail. Video ids rotate on stream restarts; camstreamer.com/embed/<id> 302s to the current id, so one HEAD per run resolves it. Would unlock ~25 video-only cams incl. snow stakes (Mt Spokane, Grand Targhee Stick of Truth, Tamarack, Brundage, Bogus Snow Marker). YouTube terms question for Chris.
